notes.title: Playtest 2.0
notes.content:
Available Now!
After a long time since the last update, here is a massive update bringing multiplayer to Elite Rogue as well as big map changes. 

The long awaited multiplayer update is finally here! 
This means you can team up to explore the updated map and the brand new one out now.
The 10 player multiplayer aims to make the roguelike experience a little different from the norm.

Map Changes
The original map has quadrupled in size and the update also brings a new map just as big, this means a lot more to explore and there are also a couple of secret places to be found!
Our newest map Electro Caves is now ready for the public after a lot of tweaks, with it comes new foes fitting the theme as well as a brand new boss.

notes.title: Development Blog: Electro Caves
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/a2ba729727b32c906aa41c13cce82f9a79b3dde9.png
Lorenzo Tatagila and his goons has built a base in the electro caves. I need YOU to bring Lorenzo down!
-Mr.B 

Greetings Voidlings! It has been a long time since our last announcement since our focus has been on developing new and old environments as well as the multiplayer feature. Here is a peek at the new map Electro Caves where Lorenzo Tatagilas goons have been busy building their hideout. This new dimension will bring with it the following content and more: 
New dimension with it's own unique theme and content
New enemies
New boss
New player items 
New music

Dimension
(new) Electro Caves 

Tatagila and his goons have been busy building their headquarters over at Electro Caves

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/1883a7aab6284a08f232316e48cf3ab790b1a486.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/4c6195471098ced7e2ca81761f51964159972441.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/8f3a5469fd15856da35663b06fb9c2902f1233b4.png
(new) Foes
Stonk rat

This tanky new foe can be found around the kitchen
"what has he been eating?"
A powerful and tanky rat that you have to shoot from afar or you will realise how hard he hits

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/98fe6922a1f16d3c7e3464a849298774e58c562a.png

Bodyguard rat

Another heavy unit equipped with military weaponry and an armoured vest
"I don't think he works for the military"
This new plated rat seems dangerous equipped with armour and heavy weapons that your gonna regret messing with

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d70ce9f06379714e08e0ea44ca7720b0b3282af2.png

Wizardo rat

Don't let this skinny magicians looks fool you
"He just scammed me out of 50 bucks!"
This rat street performance artist carries only a magicians wand, looks innocent enough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d7e802904e903da5f0e2c185cc3a63f172af5783.png

Gunner rat

The most common foe found around Electro caves
Your typical rat goon, most of Tatagilas group concists of these gunners which are weak alone but their strength lies in numbers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d875b5ce8a33e04aac9b1bfd4922578e0cc66b50.png

Items

be on the lookout for new items as well this update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/62c976947987a578d88d07f19de2beca47150000.png
Boss
new Lorenzo Tatagila

Kingpin of the rats
Lorenzo is the leader of the rat goons for a reason as you will find out..
Equipped with two light machine guns he will leave you looking like swiss cheese if you let your guard down during your visit through his domain

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/4a38b3d83bcb6d5d0d9a8efbcd7d5b5eeab718ee.png

Overall the next playtest update will be bringing along a lot of new content and variation, especially for all of the warriors who played Nightmare a bunch of times during the first playtest! Electro Caves exclusively features it's own unique foes and environment which gives the game a completely different vibe, so stay put for the next big update!

Before the big update that will be in the playtest 2.0 we will be updating you on all the major features we have been working on so far. We will also be holding polls and making your suggestions into reality over on our discord. So head on over if you want to choose what is added next!

notes.title: Playtest 2 Multiplayer update coming soon!
notes.content:
🚀Exciting News: Playtest 2 - Dimensional Jump is on the Horizon!

We're thrilled to share a sneak peek into our upcoming Playtest 2, featuring the ground-breaking multiplayer update for Elite Rogue! This major update will introduce a dynamic gaming experience, including balanced spawn rates and item drops per player, making your adventures even more thrilling.

Changes since the first playtest include:

 General balancing
 Fixed wave system
 Fixed difficulty
 Major bugfixes
 Added missing item models
 Added easter eggs


But that's not all! We're also working on a spectacular VFX update, enhancing the visual appeal of items and various in-game elements. Stay tuned for more details on this exciting addition!

 🌟Player Testimonials:
Your positive feedback has been our driving force, and we're grateful for your continued support. To share the joy, here are a few testimonials from our dedicated community:

"This is dope af" 
"Very cool to try this game out!" 
"like the game at this early stage!"

 🤯Behind the Scenes:
While we won't delve into the nitty-gritty, creating a seamless multiplayer experience is a colossal task. Our dedicated team is committed to overcoming the complexities, making Elite Rogue the best it can be.

 👥Multiplayer Highlight:
The highlight of the upcoming update? Elite Rogue will support up to 10 players! Experience the thrill of a roguelike adventure like never before. Queue up with friends or go solo — the choice is yours. 

 📸Sneak Peek:
Check out these concept pictures for a glimpse of what Elite Rogue will look like in multiplayer mode! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/748b7ea1c2cf397add2dc596acd1055d431ec829.png

 🎉Extra Addition Today:
Big news! We've implemented a new feature based on your feedback. Now, when you pick up items, a handy popup will display with the description and image of the respective items. 

 🔜Stay Tuned:
The big update is around the corner. Thank you for being a vital part of Elite Rogue's journey. Your feedback has shaped this game, and we can't wait to share these exciting additions with you. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready for an epic adventure!

notes.title: Enemy Spotlight - Spawner
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/12b232a0c88131b9347da7913a6b2f132bedd137.png
INTRODUCTION:
Spawners are elite flying summoner units, known as the "scum of nightmare." They keep their distance from players and birth kamikaze drones that seek and explode on impact. Identifying clueless drones indicates the presence of a nearby spawner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/d8fd04bafc47b97c855bfbaebf8f313afa56a578.png
GAME STATS:
Spawner Level 1:
HP: 50
DMG: 34.5
Armor: 1 (Note: Inflicts damage through spawned drones)
HOW TO DEAL WITH IT:
The Spawner itself deals no damage, but its spawned drones pose a threat. Players need to be prepared to one-shot the drones, while prioritizing the elimination of the Spawner to prevent being overwhelmed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/a1bd426d2f30cecec179d7bd567eae749f330706.png
LORE:
The Spawner resides in the nightmare dimension, materializing terrors and anxieties. Its mysterious background includes being a former cook for Zahir. The lore is intentionally vague, with room for interpretation. Suggestions are welcome.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/21a159b7c8b3651f33f4326ad0692f964774577a.png
CONCLUSION:
Sharing information before the game's release ensures players are informed and excited. It provides a guide for dealing with the Spawner and adds to the game's lore. The devblog aims to create interest, generate hype, and offer a preview for those wanting to learn more about the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/412c043952fc6d9b9f4010370204d10594262554.png
